evidence_required: three actions with a one-line mechanism each

marking.criterion: (a) Pending: drain when free, reset, verify pending cleared, diagnostics, return; mechanism: remap active only after reset
(b) Remapping failure: quarantine and RMA; mechanism: no spare row in the bank
(c) Remapped, nothing pending: healthy, monitor only; does not treat it as a fault

title: Row-remapper states
